data.body:
[P1] Preserve original SDK activity in retirement audits

The comparison omits original `sdkRequests` and invocation completion times. A failed case can retain a dispatch at 19,000 ms while its retirement snapshot drops that dispatch and declares settlement at 15,000 ms, observation end at 20,000, and retirement at 21,000. Both audits accept the reduced snapshot and release the target despite the contradictory activity. Preserve original SDK request records and require each invocation's settlement to cover its original last activity, including completion times. Add a regression for an omitted SDK dispatch.
